title: Audit a proposed CSV join
description: Supply two small CSV strings and an exact key column. Each CSV is limited at runtime to 200000 UTF-8 bytes, 500 data rows and 50 columns. Values are compared literally; no trimming, numeric coercion or deduplication. Use only data you are authorized to process on Apify.

observationsCsv.title: Observations CSV
observationsCsv.description: Header plus observation rows. Repeated observation keys are allowed. Strings such as 001 and NA stay literal.

lookupCsv.title: Lookup CSV
lookupCsv.description: Header plus lookup rows. Any duplicate nonblank key blocks the join, even if duplicate rows are identical.

key.title: Exact shared key column
key.description: One exact column name present in both headers. Maximum 100 characters.
